def iterkeys(self) -> Iterator[str]:
	"""Dict-like iterkeys() that returns an iterator of names of cookies
	from the jar.

	.. seealso:: itervalues() and iteritems().
	"""
	for cookie in iter(self):
		yield cookie.name

def itervalues(self) -> Iterator[str | None]:
	"""Dict-like itervalues() that returns an iterator of values of cookies
	from the jar.

	.. seealso:: iterkeys() and iteritems().
	"""
	for cookie in iter(self):
		yield cookie.value

def iteritems(self) -> Iterator[tuple[str, str | None]]:
	"""Dict-like iteritems() that returns an iterator of name-value tuples
	from the jar.

	.. seealso:: iterkeys() and itervalues().
	"""
	for cookie in iter(self):
		yield cookie.name, cookie.value

def __getitem__(self, name: str) -> str | None:
	"""Dict-like __getitem__() for compatibility with client code. Throws
	exception if there are more than one cookie with name. In that case,
	use the more explicit get() method instead.

	.. warning:: operation is O(n), not O(1).
	"""
	return self._find_no_duplicates(name)

def test_mixed_case_scheme_acceptable(self, httpbin, scheme):
	s = requests.Session()
	s.proxies = getproxies()
	parts = urlparse(httpbin("get"))
	url = scheme + parts.netloc + parts.path
	r = requests.Request("GET", url)
	r = s.send(r.prepare())
	assert r.status_code == 200, f"failed for scheme {scheme}"

def test_get(self):

	cid["spam"] = "oneval"

def test_equality(self):
	cid = CaseInsensitiveDict({"SPAM": "blueval", "Eggs": "redval"})
	othercid = CaseInsensitiveDict({"spam": "blueval", "eggs": "redval"})
	assert cid == othercid
	del othercid["spam"]
	assert cid != othercid
	assert cid == {"spam": "blueval", "eggs": "redval"}
	assert cid != object()

	"""The session object associated with this context. Accessed through

	return updated_item

	finally:
		await file.seek(position)
